name: Arraiolos Open 2025
information: Se vais competir pela primeira vez, certifica-te que lês todas as informações em [Informação Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ArraiolosOpen2025#50930-informacao-importante-important-information), *[ Perguntas Frequentes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ArraiolosOpen2025#50931-perguntas-frequentes-faq)* e no [Regulamento WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Se és associado da APS tens direito a um **desconto exclusivo de 20%**, sabe mais [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ArraiolosOpen2025#50934-associados-aps-aps-associates). • If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in [Important Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ArraiolosOpen2025#50930-informacao-importante-important-information), the *[FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ArraiolosOpen2025#50931-perguntas-frequentes-faq)* and the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).
